fields.prompt: What stage is the project at right now?
What are you building? Tell me what it should do, who it's for, and where it will be used — in your own words.
Which of these services apply to your project — System Architecture, Hardware Design, Firmware, Integration? Name the ones you need; I won't assume any from the description.
When are you hoping to start? A specific date if you have one — vague timing is fine too, and I'll record it as an open item rather than guess a date.
And roughly when do you need to wrap up? Skip this if you only have a start date — I won't invent an end date.
What currency is the budget in? US dollars are the default.
Do you have a rough budget in mind? Even a ballpark works.
What constraints matter most — form factor, power, environment, thermal limits, or parts you've already chosen?
Do any compliance requirements or certifications apply — for example FCC, CE, or safety standards? 'None' or 'not sure' are fine answers.
Are there tools the engineer must know or use for this project?
Any preferred tools, platforms, or toolchains?
What are the main project deliverables you'll need at the end? Things like schematics, BOM, manufacturing files, firmware binary, test reports.
Anything you're unsure about? 'I don't know yet' is a legitimate answer — those become open items for the engineer, not gaps I'll fill in.
Any design risks you're already aware of?
Anything else that would help — team background, prior work, how you like to collaborate?
